items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Joseph Henry Lide, and I was born in Worcester, England on the 13th of July, 1934.

ctx.x: I'm going to start with just asking you to give you a full name and the date and place of your birth.
Joseph Henry Lide, and I was born in Worcester, England on the 13th of July, 1934.
And what's your legal address now, Joe? I mean, where would you vote if you voted?
